# S4.15 — C1 measurement depth: corpus strata, hosted participation, foreign interchange, judge oracles

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.14b` (PR #78) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the C1 measurement depth across the benchmark adapter,
corpus, evaluation, results-analysis, bundle, ledger,
telemetry, hosting, and experiment seams. `hh-bench` gains
the `adapter_declaration/1` contract surface:
`AdapterDeclaration` (id, version identity, suite family,
`families_supported`, `submission_kind`, verifier isolations,
`export_formats`, `hosting_surfaces_supported`, optional
`parity_ref`, provenance) built from each adapter's declared
facts — never inferred — with `HostingSurfaceUnsupported` /
`ExportFormatUnsupported` refusals and `parity = none`
enforcing product-only granularity (`R-2.9.4` C1, ADR-0308
D1/D2). The corpus grows to six strata — `b` (`swe_fresh`)
admitted to the headline only through the load-time
`SuiteValidityRecord::l2_check` (epoch-seeded + dispatch ref,
flawed tasks marked never dropped) and `g`
(`harbor_index`) as the smoke stratum (ADR-0308 D3). Foreign
interchange lands as explicit lowering: `harbor_trial_dir`
export and Harness-Bench result import carry a
`LoweringLossReport`/`LossEntry` naming every dropped member,
with `unverified` provenance on imported rows (ADR-0308 D4);
`declare`/export transport over the `hh_bench_adapter` binary
keeps the out-of-process surface honest. Native and hosted
participants run the identical adapter lifecycle — hosted
surfaces are declarations checked at the boundary
(AC-R-2.9.4-{9,10}).

`hh-eval` gains judge oracles: `admit_judge` requires
calibration and independence (beneficiary-context/snapshot
sharing, family overclaim, and model-claim-only evidence all
refuse), and `emit_judged` keeps judged values in the
`*_judged` families beside — never inside — deterministic
metrics; `execution_alignment_failure_rate{,_judged}` are
distinct catalogue families (`R-2.9.2²`, AC-R-2.9.2-14,
ADR-0308 D5). `hh-analysis` parses `capability_vector`
strictly — verbatim projection, supported admits, absent/
unsupported lands typed `n/a{reason}`, unknown spellings and
malformed members refuse (ADR-0308 D6). `hh-experiment`
validates and stamps env fault/perturbation profile
overrides at launch (unknown profile, non-string member, and
cross-level disagreement all refuse).

M12 run-tree rollup (`cost_view_run_tree` — children counted
exactly once under the parent's `subagent` scope; malformed
trees refuse), M18 hosted ingestion
(`participant_reported` / `reconstructed_from_native_log`
row classes), interchange cost-view export with declared
`unit_conversion` loss, hosted-participant bundle claims
(version + drift data), lineage export with audit head, and
`rotate`/`migrate_id` end-to-end over chained runs
(AC-R-2.12.1-6) round out the `R-2.9.1¹`/`R-2.12.1¹` legs
(`R-2.9.1¹` AC-R-2.9.1-9).

Requirement ids: `R-2.9.4`, `R-2.9.1¹`, `R-2.12.1¹`,
`R-2.9.2²`.
Gates: `AC-R-2.9.1-9`, `AC-R-2.9.2-14`, `AC-R-2.9.4-{9,10}`,
`AC-R-2.12.1-6`, `removability(0…3)` — all deterministic.

## What changed

- **`crates/hh-bench`** — `adapter.rs`:
  `adapter_declaration/1` (`AdapterDeclaration`,
  `HostingSurface`, `ExportFormat` closed sums,
  `admits_granularity`/`admits_surface`/`admits_export_format`,
  `GranularityRefused`/`HostingSurfaceUnsupported`/
  `ExportFormatUnsupported`); `adapters.rs`: `decl_facts()`
  per adapter (A–E parity-bearing, G `parity = none`,
  native-only); `benchset.rs`: six-stratum corpus,
  `SuiteValidityRecord::l2_check` load gate, flawed-task
  marking (retired-for-headline, reasons, audit refs, split
  assignments/hashes); `foreign.rs` (new): lossy
  `harbor_trial_dir` export + Harness-Bench `import_result`
  under `unverified` provenance, `LoweringLossReport`/
  `LossEntry` accounting; `bin/hh_bench_adapter.rs`:
  `declare` + export ops over the stdio transport; fixtures:
  `suite.swe_fresh` (4 tasks) + `suite.harbor_index`
  (2 smoke tasks) + validity/audit members on every manifest.
- **`crates/hh-eval`** — `judge.rs` (new):
  `JudgeContext`/`JudgeAdmission`/`admit_judge` (calibration +
  independence gates), `emit_judged` (calibrated → gated
  verdict, uncalibrated → `exploratory` only, judged never on
  a deterministic metric); `catalogue.rs`: the
  `execution_alignment_failure_rate{,_judged}` families.
- **`crates/hh-analysis`** — `project.rs`: strict
  `capability_vector` parsing — verbatim projection,
  supported → admit, absent/unsupported → typed
  `n/a{reason}`, unknown spelling/malformed member → typed
  refusal.
- **`crates/hh-experiment`** — `engine.rs`: env
  fault/perturbation profile overrides validated at launch
  (unknown id, non-string member, disagreeing levels all
  refuse) and stamped onto the manifest.
- **`crates/hh-ledger`** — `tests/s4_15.rs`:
  `ac_r_2_12_1_6_rotate_corpus_over_chained_runs` — rotation
  checkpoints + `migrate_id` over a run chain (builds on
  ADR-0307's record shape).
- **`crates/hh-bundle`** — hosted-participant bundle claims
  (participant version + drift data), lineage export with
  audit head, `interchange_trajectory` cost-view lowering
  with declared `unit_conversion` losses.
- **`crates/hh-telemetry`** — `cost_view_run_tree`: M12
  rollup counting each child's resource totals exactly once
  under `subagent` scope; malformed tree shapes refuse.
- **`crates/hh-hosting`** — M18 ingestion:
  `lift_event_rows` classifies native hosted records as
  `participant_reported` (live session-ABI reports) vs
  `reconstructed_from_native_log` (reconstructed rows).
- **`crates/hh-fleet` / `crates/hh-embed`** — hosted/fleet
  participation support over the same adapter and fleet op
  surfaces.

## Tests

- `hh-bench` — `tests/s4_15.rs` (10): declaration members,

  undeclared export format refusals, stratum-B validity gate,
  hosted≡native lifecycle, foreign export + Harness-Bench
  import round trip, typed import refusal, G smoke at product

- `hh-eval` — `tests/s4_15.rs` (12): admission refusals

  independence minimums, model-claim-only), uncalibrated →
  exploratory, calibrated → gated verdict, judged never on
  deterministic metrics, alignment-detector family
  separation.
- `hh-analysis` — `tests/s4_15.rs` (5): verbatim projection,
  supported admit, typed `n/a`, unknown-spelling and
  malformed-member refusals.
- `hh-experiment` — `tests/engine.rs` (5 new): profile
  stamping, absent-profile no-op, unknown/non-string/
  disagreeing-level refusals.
- `hh-bundle` — `tests/s4_15.rs` (3): hosted bundle claims,
  interchange unit-conversion loss, Harbor lineage export.
- `hh-ledger` — `tests/s4_15.rs` (1): AC-R-2.12.1-6 rotation
  e2e.
- `hh-telemetry` — run-tree rollup + malformed-tree refusal;
  `hh-hosting` — M18 classification legs.
